title: Tiny Test World
intro: A two-room world used to exercise every engine mechanic.
win_epilogue: The gem flares, and the world folds neatly away.

room_a.name: Room A
room_a.description: A bare room with a statue against the far wall. A door leads east.
room_a.alt_description: A bare room with a cracked statue against the far wall. A door leads east.

room_b.name: Room B
room_b.description: A smaller room, empty except for a robot. A door leads west.

door_ab.name: connecting door
door_ab.description: A plain door between the two rooms.

rock.name: rock
rock.description: A fist-sized rock with sharp edges.

statue.name: statue
statue.description: A stone statue of a forgotten figure. Something rattles inside it.
statue.alt_description: The statue is cracked open, its hollow chest empty.

gem.name: gem
gem.description: A green gem that catches light there isn't any of.

robot.name: robot
robot.description: A small tin robot with a patient expression.

dialogue.text: The robot whirs to attention. "Oh! A visitor. Hello."
The robot nods. "Still here. Still waiting."

interactions.message: You crack the rock against the statue. Its chest splits open and a gem tumbles out.
You hold the gem up. It drinks in the light and hums.
